query: What does error SPN-CR-001 mean and what is the remedy?
ground_truth_answer: SPN-CR-001 is Spindle Bearing Catastrophic Failure (CRITICAL). Remedy: Replace spindle bearing set. Re-grease per OEM specification. Run acceptance test program SPD-TEST-001 before production restart.

query: I'm seeing SPN-MJ-002 - Spindle Bearing Vibration Major. What should I do?
ground_truth_answer: SPN-MJ-002 indicates Spindle Bearing Vibration exceeding ISO 10816-3 Zone C limit. Action: Schedule spindle bearing replacement within 8 hours. Reduce spindle speed by 30% until replacement. Do not run over 6000 RPM.

query: Error AXS-CR-001 - Axis Following Error Emergency Stop
ground_truth_answer: AXS-CR-001 is critical axis following error exceeding emergency stop threshold (2.0mm). Do not move axes until cause identified. Repair mechanical cause. Re-home all axes before resuming production.

query: Spindle overtemperature warning SPN-MJ-001
ground_truth_answer: SPN-MJ-001 - Spindle Motor Overtemperature. Actions: Check spindle cooling fan rotation, inspect and clean air filter, verify coolant flow, reduce spindle load. If repeated, replace cooling fan motor.

query: What is SPN-SR-001 fault code?
ground_truth_answer: SPN-SR-001 - Spindle Load Gradually Increasing (Tool Wear Trend). Severity: SERIOUS. Action: Replace tool at next part completion. Update tool life counter. Optimise cutting parameters.

query: How to respond to AXS-MJ-001 following error?
ground_truth_answer: AXS-MJ-001 - Axis Following Error Major Limit. Check servo gain parameters, inspect guide lubrication, measure backlash. Re-tune servo gain. Lubricate linear guides. If backlash >0.02mm, schedule ball screw inspection.

query: SPN-CR-002 spindle drive overcurrent
ground_truth_answer: SPN-CR-002 - Spindle Drive Overcurrent Hard Fault (CRITICAL). Do not reset drive until root cause identified. Check motor insulation resistance, inspect drive power stage, verify no mechanical obstruction, check torque log. Replace faulty drive module or motor.

query: Error SPN-WN-001 tool life warning
ground_truth_answer: SPN-WN-001 - Spindle Load Tool Life 80% Consumed. Action: Prepare replacement tool. Visually inspect tool at next opportunity. Schedule tool change at end of current batch.

query: What does SPN-MN-002 indicate?
ground_truth_answer: SPN-MN-002 - Spindle Motor Temperature Elevated. Minor severity. Action: Check air filter cleanliness, verify coolant flow, compare ambient to historical. Clean filters at next shift break. Monitor trend.

query: Servo drive thermal warning AXS-MJ-002
ground_truth_answer: AXS-MJ-002 - Servo Drive Thermal Warning. Remedy: Check cabinet fans are operational, clean drive heatsink fins, reduce duty cycle, check ambient temperature. If recurring, upsize drive cooling.

query: What are the specifications for spindle bearing replacement?
ground_truth_answer: Spindle bearing replacement requires OEM-spec grease, re-greasing per OEM specification, and acceptance test program SPD-TEST-001. Operating range P004: 0-4.5 mm/s normal, critical threshold 11.2 mm/s.

query: What is the tool change procedure for VMC-3000?
ground_truth_answer: Tool change procedure follows TCS-TEST-002 acceptance cycle. Spindle orientation must be within ±0.5 degrees. Verify orientation switch target disk alignment and pneumatic brake actuation.

query: Describe the X-axis servo mechanism and lubrication points.
ground_truth_answer: X-axis servo uses ball screw with linear guides. Backlash limit is 0.02mm. Lubrication at guide surfaces with specified grease. Servo current normal range: 0-18A, critical: 0-25A.

query: What cooling system maintenance is required for the spindle?
ground_truth_answer: Spindle cooling requires regular fan rotation check, air filter inspection and cleaning (monthly), coolant flow verification if liquid-cooled, and oil mist lubrication nozzle P040 maintenance.

query: How to check spindle encoder signal quality?
ground_truth_answer: Clean encoder disc with IPA, check mounting bolts torque, inspect cable routing for pinches, measure signal quality on oscilloscope, verify shield continuity to ground. Expected missing pulses per rev: <0.5.

query: What is the vibration monitoring procedure?
ground_truth_answer: Vibration RMS normal range: 0-4.5 mm/s (ISO Zone B acceptable for long-term operation). Kurtosis index 2.5-5.0 normal. Early defect threshold: kurtosis >8.0. Use handheld analyser at spindle nose.

query: Describe foundation bolt re-torquing procedure.
ground_truth_answer: Re-torque foundation bolts to specification quarterly. Check and re-torque when vibration RMS increases 10% over 7 days. Loosening increases baseline vibration and degrades accuracy.

query: What maintenance interval is required for ball screw inspection?
ground_truth_answer: Ball screw inspection required annually or when following error exceeds 0.5mm. Measure backlash — if >0.02mm, schedule inspection. Grease ball screw support bearing at every 500 operating hours.

query: How to verify correct tool length offset?
ground_truth_answer: Verify tool length with probe if available after tool breakage indication. Review NC block G-code for programmed depth of cut. First-off inspection required before resuming production.

query: What are the spindle motor temperature thresholds?
ground_truth_answer: P003 Spindle Motor Temperature: normal 20-75°C, critical 0-95°C. Major threshold: 85°C (thermal model predicts critical in <15 min). Check drive heatsink temperature during thermal overcurrent.

query: Customer reports spindle not spinning up to full speed
ground_truth_answer: Common causes: SPN-NC-001 speed limit active via G50 command, SPN-SR-002 encoder signal degraded, or SPN-MJ-001 motor overtemperature with thermal protection. Verify speed limit is intentional. Check encoder disc contamination.

query: Tool changing takes longer than normal
ground_truth_answer: Possible SPN-CR-003 Spindle Orientation Failure. Check spindle encoder cable continuity, verify orientation switch target disk alignment, inspect pneumatic brake actuation pressure, test orientation cycle manually in JOG mode.

query: Machine stops with following error during rapid traverse
ground_truth_answer: Check AXS-CR-001 (emergency stop at 2mm) vs AXS-MJ-001 (major at 0.5mm). Do not move axes until cause identified. Re-home all axes. Check servo drive status LEDs and ball screw for damage.

query: Operator noticed excessive spindle vibration and noise
ground_truth_answer: Likely SPN-MJ-002 bearing defect or SPN-MJ-004 chatter. Measure bearing vibration RMS. If >7.1 mm/s indicates defect. Adjust spindle speed ±10% to shift stable lobe. Check tool holder for imbalance.

query: Customer getting overload fault on X-axis servo during heavy cut
ground_truth_answer: Check servo current P013 (normal 0-18A). Verify no mechanical obstruction. Re-tune servo gain against commissioning record. If sustained >20A, check DC bus voltage P090 for undervoltage.

query: Spindle cooling fan is not running - spindle temperature rising
ground_truth_answer: SPN-MJ-001 prevention. Inspect spindle cooling fan (P071 cabinet fans check). Verify fan is operational. Check motor cooling lines for blockage. Run warm-up program SPD-WARMUP-001 only if motor temp <20°C after idle.

query: Tool life counter showing inconsistent values between parts
ground_truth_answer: Verify tool life calibration matches actual tool. Check surface finish on last produced part — poor finish indicates worn tool. SPN-SR-001 gradual load increase indicates progression. Update tool life counter accuracy in table.

query: Machine going into alarm when feed override is applied
ground_truth_answer: SPN-MD-002 Feed Override Active — non-standard condition detected if override active >10 parts. Verify correct tool loaded. Interview operator for reason override applied. Restore nominal feed rate. Review cutting parameters.

query: Axis positioning accuracy degraded over time
ground_truth_answer: Check AXS-MJ-001 following error threshold (0.5mm). Inspect axis guide lubrication (dry guides cause friction). Measure ball screw backlash (limit 0.02mm). Run servo tuning cycle. Schedule ball screw inspection if backlash exceeded.

query: Intermittent M code errors during tool change program
ground_truth_answer: Verify TCS-TEST-002 acceptance cycle runs. SPN-CR-003 blocks tool change if spindle orientation fails (error >0.5°). Check proximity switch target disk alignment. Test orientation cycle manually in JOG mode first.
